title: Use tool contract for Tactus planner phase
description: The Tactus planner phase still fails model-native structured output validation. Preserve the planner agent, but make it complete by calling a record_plan tool so Kanbus can evaluate a production-shaped multi-agent procedure using tool contracts.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Changed the planner phase from model-native structured output to an explicit record_plan tool contract. This preserves a separate planner agent while making the phase observable through Tactus tool semantics.
